title: Holiday Red Manicure Color Palette from My Art, HEX Codes | Pigeon Polly
desc: A nail color palette pulled from my artwork “Red nail polish”: Tomato #C63A31, Brick #BB6764, Latte #AB8771, Ink Black #130D0D and Linen #E7E0CE.
